promise: Answer a bounded question over long material with exact evidence and visible coverage limits.
audience: People and agents examining long documents or collections.
trigger: Material exceeds comfortable context and a focused question needs evidence.

modes.name: Extract
modes.when: Exact passages or identifiers are needed.
modes.output: Bounded extractive evidence with offsets and line references.

modes.name: Synthesize
modes.when: Evidence is sufficient for an answer.
modes.output: A source-linked synthesis with unresolved gaps.

modes.name: Resume
modes.when: A bounded job stopped before covering the input.
modes.output: A verified continuation against the same source hash.

examples.title: Find an export definition
examples.brief: Use Long Read on a fictional long specification to find where an export format is defined. Set an explicit chunk budget, keep exact passages and locations, and report the inspected coverage. If the budget ends, save the job rather than claiming the full document was reviewed.
examples.before: An answer summarizes only the beginning of a long report as though the whole was read.
examples.after: An explicit chunk budget, source fingerprint and cited excerpts show the inspected coverage.
examples.why: Coverage limits remain visible when a job stops or resumes.

boundaries: The independent helper is extractive and lexical; semantic completeness and answer correctness require review.

verification.name: Functional acceptance
verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 51 native unit tests passed, 7 live/integration skips; Docker/provider acceptance is separate.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

sources.role: Primary retained owner history, mechanisms and records; portable method consolidates the listed entry points.

consolidation: One portable method entry with mode references; original native engines, agents and records retained as optional adapters.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.

marketing.headline: Read toward a question. Keep the evidence and the gaps.
marketing.lead: For people examining long documents or collections. Long Read retrieves exact passages for a focused question, records the inspected coverage and resumes against the same source revision, so you can see what an answer rests on.

benefits.title: Find a passage you can cite
benefits.body: Keep character offsets, line references and a source fingerprint with the extracted evidence.

benefits.title: Stop without losing your place
benefits.body: Save a bounded job and resume it only if the source hash still matches.

benefits.title: Keep coverage honest
benefits.body: Show searched chunks and unfinished work instead of presenting the beginning of a document as a full review.

walkthrough.title: Ask a bounded question
walkthrough.detail: Choose the material and what would count as enough evidence to answer.

walkthrough.title: Extract and inspect
walkthrough.detail: Run the no-model lexical helper, then read the returned passages and nearby context.

walkthrough.title: Answer or continue
walkthrough.detail: Cite the evidence, mark unresolved coverage and resume the saved job when the source is unchanged.

use_when: A document exceeds comfortable context and you have a focused question.
You need exact identifiers, passages or source locations.
Work must stop and resume with evidence from one stable revision.
not_for: A guarantee that lexical search understands every relevant meaning.
Treating no match as proof that the source contains nothing relevant.
marketing.quickstart_prompt: Use Long Read on a fictional long specification to find where an export format is defined. Set an explicit chunk budget, keep exact passages and locations, and report the inspected coverage. If the budget ends, save the job rather than claiming the full document was reviewed.
marketing.output_preview:
Question: where is the export format defined?
Source: specification.txt, fingerprint recorded
Evidence: exact excerpt with line and character locations
Coverage: searched chunks / total chunks
Job: saved for continuation if the budget ends

Answer: cite the inspected passage.
Unresolved: terminology outside the lexical query may need another pass.
marketing.example_note: Fictional evidence receipt. Counts and excerpts are deliberately omitted because no document was scanned for this illustration.
install_notes: Python 3.11 or later is required by the portable install/build helper. The installed method runs through your agent host.
The portable Python helper works without Docker or a model key and accepts UTF-8 input up to its documented size bound.
A native recursive engine remains optional and needs its own provider, isolation and explicit budgets.
Source-hash and saved-hit integrity checks reject changed or inconsistent continuation state.
marketing.proof_summary: The extractive helper’s functional checks and adversarial resume-integrity cases passed; valid outputs were preserved. These checks establish bounded extraction behavior, not semantic completeness or answer quality.
marketing.next_step: Try the helper on one non-sensitive text file and inspect the returned excerpt before synthesizing an answer.

name: amplifier-capability-long-read
version_basis: Existing project metadata; not a new published tag or package release; an exact Git pin selects source for the shared portable installer.

portable_method.name: long-read
portable_method.contract: Agent Skills directory; caller applies the method; no independent execution loop is installed.

portable.input: Caller task and explicitly authorized context
portable.output: Answer a bounded question over long material with exact evidence and visible coverage limits.
portable.failure: Report insufficient evidence, unsupported context or host limitation; never turn discovery into an execution claim.

native.status: Existing declared entrypoints preserved; runtime signatures, service access and installation tests remain separate evidence.

installation.scope: Shared canonical portable installer only; not the legacy repository helper or native package installation.

runtime.status: Host/caller authorizes each operation; installation is not a tool allowlist or standing approval.
declared_boundaries: The independent helper is extractive and lexical; semantic completeness and answer correctness require review.

secret_names.native_runtime_inventory: See native documentation; no credentials are bundled or inferred.

dataflow.installation: Shared canonical portable installer only (https://michaeljabbour.github.io/reports/capability-installer/): read portable source tracked at the explicit Git pin and copy locally with SHA-256 receipts; no source text is transmitted. Legacy repository helpers copy current working-tree files and do not uniformly enforce Git pins, tracked membership or hash receipts. Native package builds and downloads have separate network, execution and storage flows described in their installation documentation.
dataflow.method: Caller supplies authorized context; existing promise and boundaries govern output.
dataflow.native_runtime: Provider/network/storage flows are owned by native interfaces and host authorization; these files do not enable them.

source_policy.revision: The shared canonical portable installer (https://michaeljabbour.github.io/reports/capability-installer/) requires an explicit full 40-character Git commit and never infers latest. This guarantee does not apply uniformly to legacy or native installers; the legacy repository helper is an operator-controlled working-tree copy without Git-pin, tracked-membership or SHA-256 receipt enforcement.
source_policy.repository_rename: Public identity may change; skill folder, imports, entrypoints, tool IDs and schemas remain stable.
source_policy.research: .research/market remains local and ignored; AGENTS governs refresh.

film.heading: Nine hundred pages. One question.
film.blurb: In 66 seconds, a fast answer reads forty pages and misses page 612. Long Read reads toward your question inside a budget you set, shows what it read and what it skipped, answers with the passage, page and line, marks its place when the budget runs out and notices a new edition. Captions are on the player; a transcript is below.
film.note: The specification, pages and fingerprints are a fictional example. The film shows how the skill behaves; it does not report results.

shared_portable.applies_when: portable_method is declared; otherwise describe native interfaces without executing installation
guarantees: Tracked portable source membership and source-byte checks

legacy_repository.documentation: Existing install_commands and repository installation documentation, where provided.
legacy_repository.source_policy: Operator-controlled current working-tree copy. It can include untracked files and can operate outside a Git checkout; no uniform Git pin or SHA-256 transaction receipt is enforced.
legacy_repository.permissions: Review the specific command and destination; shared-installer transaction and permission guarantees do not describe this route.

native.documentation: interfaces.native, runtime_install_commands and project installation documentation, where provided.
native.source_policy: Native packaging, host composition and download routes retain their own version and provenance rules; shared portable receipt guarantees do not automatically apply.
native.permissions: Package builds may execute build tools; dependency or artifact downloads may use the network. Review the documented command, dependencies, destination and runtime authorization separately.
